Old FIA service weapon. Perfectly balanced and reliable — everything an NUSA agent could ever want.

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 2,500eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic EQ Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 10 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: Yes

Slots: N/A • Attachments: TUp (Advanced) IR/UV Laser Sight, Power Rebuild, TUp (Advanced) Silencer • Mods: Covert Build

Special Features: Despite being Iconic, this weapon may load Non-Basic Ammunition. When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 2d6 additional damage (5d6). The Laser Sight can be activated or deactivated as an Action. While it is active and the weapon is wielded in two hands by a user that can see in Infrared/Nightvision, they gain a +2 bonus to Aimed Shots with this weapon but suffer a -2 penalty to Stealth Checks against characters utilizing Infrared/Nightvision [Advanced Laser Sight]. Perception Checks made to hear this weapon firing are always set to a minimum of DV19 regardless of environment and proximity to the listener [Advanced Silencer]. This weapon is undetectable by security scanners and similar systems [Covert Build].

Fabrication: DV29 - 2,500eb - 1 Month
Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: TUp (Advanced) IR/UV Laser Sight, Power Rebuild, TUp (Advanced) Silencer (effects already included in these stats)
Mods: Covert Build

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
